articles.title: Only half of England's young workers outside higher education secure permanent contracts, down from 81%
articles.source: Phys.org - latest science and technology news stories
articles.summary: The study of young people in England found that among those who did not progress to higher education, only 16% secured apprenticeships and just 23% had secured stable work by ages 19–20. Of those in work, only half had a permanent contract, down from 81% in a similar study six years ago.

articles.title: Microplastics found in wild mammals' blood more than 40 miles from human infrastructure
articles.source: Phys.org - latest science and technology news stories
articles.summary: Animals, like humans, are taking up increasing amounts of tiny plastic particles. Such microplastics are demonstrably hazardous to many species under experimental conditions, and it is suspected that they may also pose a threat to animals in the wild. While data about microplastic concentrations in the terrestrial environment exist, it has not yet been clear if higher exposure also translates into higher microplastic accumulation in individual animals. A new paper published in Nature now confirms this link.

articles.title: Where are all the males? Ancient human fossils reveal a startling mystery
articles.summary: A remarkable discovery in a South African cave suggests that an extinct human relative may have created an all-female burial site more than 240,000 years ago.
